analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 39.4, entering oversold territory, continuing its decline from 64.0 five days ago. MACD histogram worsened to -35.7358, maintaining a bearish trend. While the 5-day low is not lower than the 20-day low, the 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, confirming a bearish pattern. The current price of $2,489.87 requires support confirmation near the lower Bollinger Band ($2,521.85).
